I would now like to draw your attention to the pledge for justice initiative, which will be one of the special features of the high level segment of the 15th Congress. The initiative is intended to provide a visible platform for member states to make concrete time bound commitments to advance crime prevention, criminal justice and thereby help translate the political commitments of the Congress into practical action beyond Abu Dhabi. Pledges may take different forms.
